title: Beyond conventional lithium-ion: anode-free lithium metal batteries for ultra-high energy and greener storage solutions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28141-28166
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01751G, Review Article

Zewdu Tadesse Wondimkun, Haojie Fei, Nikhitha Joseph, Petr Sáha
Anode-free lithium metal batteries achieve stable cycling through controlled Li deposition and nucleation. Electrolyte design, cycling protocols, and surface modifications enable uniform Li+ flux and robust artificial SEI formation.
